requests.submitted_prose: On this Court's assessment, the Mimanis could not demand automatic restoration from the State under the expired, unrenewed lease when they no longer occupied the land. Protection against forcible dispossession of a continuing occupant was distinguished; reserved independent remedies remain open.

checked_scope.statement: On this Court's assessment, the Mimanis could not demand automatic restoration from the State under the expired, unrenewed lease when they no longer occupied the land. rule_scope_limits: Target factual conjunction: State possession, expired lease without renewal, restoration stage. Do not generalize to forcible eviction of an occupant.
Reconstruct refusal of automatic restoration in this requisition setting, not a universal denial of possessory protection.

This procedural criticism did not establish entitlement to restoration.

policy: Submitted natural-language prose is displayed only as an unverified claim; the conditional conclusion is rendered from the reviewed rule and explicit binding.
interpretation: This display prevents status labels from endorsing arbitrary prose. It does not detect semantic errors in prose or approved translations.
